decisions.reason: The earmold for in-ear systems remains a low-cost option with uncertain but promising niche demand, so it is kept open while the market signal resolves.
Its dedicated product page and clear positioning suggest an active commitment, and with no negative results the option is retained as uncertainty is still high.
The vacuum thermoforming unit may carry higher keeping costs, but without evidence that its value will not be realized, the option is kept while the firm assesses demand.
